basic_details.job_title: PBTI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 7 Scientific Assistant, Assistant Scientific Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Biotechnology Incubator (PBTI), Department of Science, Technology & Environment, Government of Punjab, has invited applications for 7 posts: Administrative cum Finance & Accounts Officer, Assistant Scientific Officer (Analytical/Instrumentation), Junior Scientific Officer (Analytical/Instrumentation) and four Scientific Assistant posts. The posts are filled through direct recruitment purely on a contractual basis for 5 years. The last date for submission of applications is 25 December 2026, and the detailed advertisement and application form are on PBTI's website, pbtilabs.punjab.gov.in

content_sections.heading: About PBTI
content_sections.text: Punjab Biotechnology Incubator (PBTI) works under the Department of Science, Technology & Environment, Government of Punjab. Its office is at GoP Knowledge City, Sector-81, SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab-140306, where the advertised posts are located. The notice was published in The Tribune, Hindustan Times and Ajit, and is signed by PBTI's Admin cum Fin & Accounts Officer.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Any corrigendum to this recruitment notice will be published on the same website, pbtilabs.punjab.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: PBTI is filling 7 posts, one post each. Pay is the minimum admissible pay per month as per the 7th CPC. UR stands for Unreserved and SCW for Scheduled Caste Woman. Post 7 (Scientific Assistant – SCW) is reserved for a Scheduled Caste woman; posts 1 to 6 are unreserved. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Experience and age limit: not specified in the notice. Terms: direct recruitment purely on a contractual basis for a period of 5 years, extendable as per requirement of PBTI.

rows.event: Notice published in newspapers (The Tribune, HT, Ajit)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PBTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: PBTI Recruitment 2026 has 7 vacancies, one each for seven posts: 6 Unreserved and 1 reserved for a Scheduled Caste Woman.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PBTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for PBTI posts?
faq.answer: The minimum admissible pay per month as per the 7th CPC is Rs. 47,600 for Administrative cum Finance & Accounts Officer and Assistant Scientific Officer, Rs. 35,400 for Junior Scientific Officer and Rs. 29,200 for each Scientific Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. Where can I get the PBTI application form?
faq.answer: The detailed advertisement and application form are on PBTI's website, pbtilabs.punjab.gov.in.

faq.question: Q5. Are the PBTI posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled through direct recruitment purely on a contractual basis for a period of 5 years, extendable as per requirement of PBTI.

faq.question: Q6. Which PBTI post is reserved for a Scheduled Caste Woman?
faq.answer: Post 7, Scientific Assistant – SCW, is reserved for a Scheduled Caste Woman; all other posts are unreserved.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for PBTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts are at Punjab Biotechnology Incubator, GoP Knowledge City, Sector-81, SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab-140306.
